description: Skelet G00-05 plan-amendment exact-diff review: incorporate URL-to-Build-Kit successor phase P09b (issue 9) into canonical plan

state.exact_diff:
diff --git PRODUCT.md
@@ -58,7 +58,7 @@
 - Lens URL analysis;
 + Lens URL analysis and URL-to-Build-Kit export;

diff --git docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
@@ section 8
 +### 8.1 Lens Build Kit successor (P09b, normative; tracks issue #9)
 +The Lens report (section 8) is extended by a bounded successor phase P09b, turning a qualified Lens analysis into a downloadable agent-usable build starter; additive Lens capability, not a new editor/app builder/clone.
 +Contract: stable AnalysisRun/kit IDs; idempotent submission; poll/cancel/retry/resume; artifact expiration; tenant-scoped storage/access; per-job quotas; versioned schemas; deterministic error classification.
 +Job states: queued/capturing/extracting/generating/validating/completed/partial/failed/canceled. Never return a successful empty artifact.
 +Bounded scope: single public page default; explicitly selected same-site pages or bounded sitemap crawl under page/depth/byte/time budgets; preserve per-page coverage gaps.
 +Generated code distinguished from original source; unknown logic are explicit stubs; starter MUST install and build from clean checkout.
 +Per-item rights: restricted/trademark/unknown-license bytes MUST NOT enter downloadable artifacts; withdrawal/deletion/derivative-purge supported.
 +No mandatory paid inference/crawler/GPU/external model on deterministic path; graceful partial results on provider outage.
 +P09b successor to qualified Lens capture (R4 gate + basic Lens report first). P14 Create/OpenPencil explicitly NOT a prerequisite.
 +Layout/schemas frozen by P09b implementation grains before code lands; P15 launch acceptance includes URL-to-Build-Kit journey. Planning amendment alone implements nothing and closes no P0 risk.
@@ P09 block
 +### P09b phase: depends on qualified P09 (R4) + P03/P05 via P09. Deliverables: versioned kit schemas + fixture-validated ZIP layout; job lifecycle; UI/REST/MCP/CLI-SDK parity over stable IDs and skelet://lens/{analysis_id} URIs for second-agent recovery. Exit criteria: 3-page fixture desktop/mobile captures, deterministic tokens, component inventory, source-linked evidence, schema-valid ZIP, starter installs/typechecks/builds/starts + responsive/keyboard smoke; restricted assets excluded; SSRF/redirect/DNS-rebinding/prompt-injection/tenant-leakage/path-traversal/quota/retry/outage tests pass; no paid inference or P14 dependency.
@@ section 15
 +P09 -> P09b edge (R4 Lens report + job lifecycle first; P14 not a prerequisite).
 +P15 dependency line gains P09b; launch acceptance explicitly includes URL-to-Build-Kit journey.
 +Minimum paid launch scope: Lens URL analysis and URL-to-Build-Kit export (P09b).
No code, schemas, CI workflows, dependencies, or runtime behavior changed.
